coveragePolicy: Use the contiguous complete 2009..H macro/fiscal window. Preserve later incomplete source rows. Missing history, WDI bridge or calendar climate index blocks the calculation; a shorter usable horizon is disclosed. Undefined effective rates on zero debt retain the legacy carry/zero treatment.
inputHashDefinition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 Python json.dumps(raw payload excluding horizonPolicy, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False, ensure_ascii=True), no newline. Raw payload includes country identity and four ordered input arrays.
label: WEO April 2026 + UN WPP 2024
macrofiscal_year_max_note: Complete cached WEO release; country usable horizon checked explicitly. Baseline assumptions and incremental climate comparisons begin H+1; climate calendar unchanged, anchored at H; no catch-up.
observationStatus: LATEST_ACTUAL_ANNUAL_DATA and PUBLICATION_DATE are blank in the cached SDMX rows. Source WEO values are estimates/projections; this release does not assert a common observed/forecast cutoff.
retainedInputs: Demography, productivity and climate arrays copied without numeric changes from each old Current JSON payload; old folders unchanged.
